▸About this register — what it is and what it is for purpose, record definition, column glossary
What is the Enrollment Register?

It is the single client-wise joining record of LIFE Slimming & Cosmetic Clinic. One row = one client enrollment. It answers, for every client: who joined, when, for what treatment, under whom, at what value, and how far the treatment has moved since.

It is the source record that feeds sales, recovery, retention and audit. Every other report — dues, zero session, rebooking, therapy utilisation — is a view of what is captured here.

What it is used for
  • Sales & credit control — package value, discount taken, paid, due, next due date, invoices raised.
  • Execution control — sessions booked vs completed, appointments visited, zero-session cases, completion %.
  • Retention — last visit, last followup, average monthly visit, regular vs irregular, break and deactivated records.
  • Accountability — joined by, rebooked by, consultant, CC agent, branch manager and cluster for every record.
  • Client quality — VIP / VVIP / HNI tier, referrals given and taken, credits, concerns raised.
Key definitions
  • Main category — top level of the service master: Slimming, Skin, Hair, Aesthetics, HT, NSHR, GLP-1, LIFE RISE, Physio, Diagnostics.
  • Enrolled item — a therapy plan, signature programme or an individual service with its body part / variant.
  • Zero session — enrolled and billed but not a single session taken. Highest-priority recovery case.
  • Rebooked ×N — in-house repeat purchases after the first package. First package is never counted.
  • Tier — VIP ₹1.5L+, VVIP ₹2.5L+, HNI ₹3.5L+ on package value.
  • Regular / Irregular — 1.2 visits a month or more is regular. AMV is average monthly visit since start.
How the money is read
  • Net billed — package value less discount. Per session value = net ÷ sessions booked.
  • Paid worth — value of the sessions already delivered (per-session value × sessions done).
  • Paid covers — how many sessions the money received actually pays for.
  • Unpaid delivered — service given ahead of money. This is the branch's exposure.
  • Advance held — money collected against sessions not yet delivered; a service liability.
  • Category breakup — every figure above split main-category wise, with the used and balance value of each.
How to use this screen
  • Master filter for any combination; quick chips for the common daily pulls.
  • Search covers every page — name, mobile, alternate, client ID, card, PD form.
  • Click any row to open the client 360; use the Action column to push the record into the module that owns it.
  • Mobile numbers are masked by default; use the Numbers button on the title bar to reveal.
  • Print settings control orientation, sections and columns before printing.
